dataset.title: cytocompatibility analysis of Ti6Al4V and Ti40Zr10Cu36Pd14 bulk metallic glass
dataset.creator: Sharifikolouei, Elham
dataset.not_committed_because: The workbook is kept out of the repository: it carries the instrument serial number and a workstation account name in its header. The derived CSV holds only the typed per-well values, their sheet and cell, and the read start time and temperature.

paper.note: Read in full through the product path; only ids and the host's short readings are committed.
